select u.user_id , u.user_name , u.email , u.phone , u.user_type , u.status , u.joined_at , u.withdrawn_at , p.product_id , pd.product_name from user u left outer join pay p on u.user_id = p.user_id left outer join product pd on p.product_id = pd.product_id where u.user_type = 'p'
and p.product_id is null
and p.product_id = #{type}
and 1=1
and u.status = #{status}
and u.user_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')
order by
u.joined_at asc
u.joined_at desc
u.user_name asc
u.user_id asc

select u.user_id , u.user_name , u.email , u.phone , u.user_type , u.status , u.joined_at , u.withdrawn_at , p.birth_date , p.gender , p.country , p.pass_count , p.report_received_count , p.profile_url from user u join user_person p on u.user_id = p.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId}
select * from board_post where board_type = 'FREE' and author_member_id = #{userId}

SELECT b.ad_id, c.company_name, j.title AS job_title, p.pay_date AS pay_date, -- 시작일(결제일) cp.end_date AS expiry_date, -- 종료일 b.is_display FROM banner b LEFT JOIN USER_COMPANY c ON b.comp_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN JOB_POSTING j ON b.job_id = j.job_id LEFT JOIN com_product cp ON b.comp_id = cp.user_id AND p.pay_status = 'paid' LEFT JOIN com_product cp ON p.pay_id = cp.pay_id ORDER BY b.ad_id DESC
SELECT CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN '남성' WHEN gender = 'F' THEN '여성' ELSE '미선택' END AS label , COUNT(*) AS value FROM user_person GROUP BY gender

SELECT CASE WHEN (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(BIRTH_DATE)) BETWEEN 10 AND 19 THEN '10대' WHEN (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(BIRTH_DATE)) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20대' WHEN (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(BIRTH_DATE)) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30대' WHEN (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(BIRTH_DATE)) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40대' WHEN (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(BIRTH_DATE)) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50대' ELSE '기타' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM user_person GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
SELECT desired_role AS label , count(*) AS value FROM personal_job_profile GROUP BY desired_role ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT c.company_name AS label , count(j.job_id) AS value FROM user_company c JOIN job_posting j ON c.user_id = j.comp_id GROUP BY c.company_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT field AS label , COUNT(*) AS value FROM job_posting GROUP BY field ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT emp_type AS label , COUNT(*) AS value FROM job_posting GROUP BY emp_type
SELECT pr.product_name AS label , COUNT(*) AS value FROM product pr JOIN pay p ON p.product_id = pr.product_id GROUP BY pr.product_name
SELECT p.pay_method AS label , COUNT(*) AS value FROM pay p JOIN product pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id WHERE pr.product_type = 'user' GROUP BY p.pay_method

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pay_date, '%m-%d') AS label , SUM(P.pay_price) AS value FROM pay P JOIN product pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id WHERE p.pay_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND pr.product_type = 'user' GROUP BY label ORDER BY label ASC
SELECT c.company_name AS label , SUM(p.pay_price) AS value FROM pay p JOIN user_company c ON p.user_id = c.user_id GROUP BY c.company_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT pr.product_name AS label , COUNT(*) AS value FROM pay p JOIN user_company c ON p.user_id = c.user_id JOIN product pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id WHERE pr.product_type = 'com' GROUP BY pr.product_name

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pay_date, '%m-%d') AS label , SUM(p.pay_price) AS value FROM pay p JOIN product pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id WHERE p.pay_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND pr.product_type = 'com' GROUP BY label ORDER BY label ASC
